disposition_reason: The selected original task is the complete Figure 5A-D decoding comparison: four behaviors, five brain regions and ten IBL sessions, with every applicable source author-model condition and baseline. This is an ordered performance task, but exact panel cohort identities, preprocessing/metric provenance and numeric published results remain unrecovered. A new cohort or the separate prospective40 condition cannot establish this same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: Exploiting correlations across trials and behavioral sessions to improve neural decoding

evidence.locator: Results: Figure 5 caption and benchmarking section; Figure 8; STAR Methods: Data processing, Hyperparameter selection, bootstrap resampling; Data and code availability
evidence.supports: Identifies original decoding targets, panel-specific cohorts, performance measures, temporal inputs and final training recipe; links the author release. No exact numeric Figure 5 baseline was recovered from the reviewed text.

evidence.supports: Author software release dated 2025-10-11, archive md5 380c2bc37681e80741ab4b3f85a1fc14; this is code, not the complete empirical input dataset or a numeric performance report.

evidence.supports: Example source uses seed 42, release tables and randomized 70/10/20 trial partitions, with a fixed 20 ms stimulus-aligned input recipe. It does not authenticate every final-paper cohort and fold.
Normalization recomputes statistics despite supplied training statistics; missing behavior filling and drop_last test loading require historical recipe and exact scored-row reconciliation.

Example scorer returns flattened R2 for regression and argmax accuracy for classification, retaining per-session and per-region outputs. It does not implement the complete final-paper AUC/Pearson panel.

Example source sweeps learning rate, weight decay and rank, with 500 sweep epochs and 800 final epochs; it excludes prior from the listed target choices. This must be reconciled to the final-paper recipe before a baseline is admitted.
The paper-linked NEURON release also exposes the example accuracy/R2 evaluator, so changing the source label alone does not resolve metric provenance.

evidence.locator: Unchanged scope and outstanding inputs; behavior-PC and matched observed/imposter sections
evidence.supports: The full historical F1-F8/S1-S8 programme and prospective40 remain preserved and inactive. The Figure 5 comparison has ten sessions and five regions, but authentic original cohort/recipe and competent references remain unqualified; unrelated historical panels are not prerequisites for this selected original task.

target.description: Complete original Figure 5A-D comparison: decode choice, prior, wheel speed and whisker motion energy with all applicable single-session, multi-session, multi-region and combined author-model conditions and reported baselines.

dataset.description: IBL Reproducible Electrophysiology data used for Figure 5A-D. Exact immutable release objects and panel input manifest remain unauthenticated; the Zenodo item is software.

cohort.description: Figure 5A-D uses ten IBL sessions and region-specific decoding for PO, LP, DG, CA1 and VISa. Recover exact session/animal/unit identities and all original supported cases; neither the 10-session example selection nor prospective40 authenticates this cohort.

split.description: The released example uses randomized 70/10/20 within-session trial partitions. Establish whether this is the original panel protocol and preserve its support and state-space sequence semantics. A provenance-controlled rerun of the original stochastic protocol is valid; historical seed identity is not intrinsically required. New animal-held-out or chronological protocols are extensions.

inputs.description: Use each Figure 5A-D condition’s original neural and behavioral context. BMM-HMM/LG-AR1 may use sequence decoder outputs and permitted training-session behavior; target-session oracle behavior is excluded. Do not reinterpret this retrospective decoding task as online prediction.

preprocessing.description: Final Methods distinguish stimulus-aligned static targets and movement-aligned dynamic targets. The example cache applies one common 20 ms window; its loader recomputes normalization and fills missing behaviors. Resolve the selected panel’s original windows, masks, prior construction, scaling and row coverage without silently substituting prospective repairs.

metric.description: Figure 5A-D uses choice AUC, prior Pearson correlation and dynamic-behavior R2. The released example evaluator instead returns argmax accuracy and flattened R2. Recover panel-specific score implementation, units and undefined-value handling; do not substitute accuracy for AUC or R2 for correlation.

aggregation.description: Retain the complete original Figure 5A-D per-region, per-behavior and author-condition results across ten sessions. Recover score vectors, exact plotted summaries and full denominators; no favorable composite or available-case reduction substitutes for the original panel.

comparison.primary_metric: Complete Figure 5A-D endpoint vector: choice AUC, prior Pearson correlation, wheel-speed R2 and whisker-motion-energy R2, each across the five original regions

published_baseline.description: The exact numeric Figure 5A-D author-model results were not recovered. Identify the relevant source-model comparator for every target/region under its original access condition; a gain over only the weaker linear baseline is insufficient. No values are estimated from plotted bars.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated Figure 5A-D author rerun is established. The NEURON examples require metric/preprocessing/training reconciliation. A rerun of the source stochastic protocol with documented provenance, prespecified calibration tolerance and paired candidate comparison is admissible without requiring the identical historical random seed.

minimum_effect.rationale: Prespecify scientifically meaningful AUC, correlation and R2 effects for the selected panel, informed by author-rerun variability. A lower p-value, source reconstruction or a local weaker-baseline gain is not sufficient.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-versus-author inference for the complete Figure 5A-D comparison after recovering animal/session identities and original stochastic protocol. Include rerun randomness and endpoint/region multiplicity, retaining paired cases and dependent trials.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological animal for generalization inference, with repeated sessions and multiple regions nested; trials and time bins are not independent animals. Recover original ten-session animal mapping before selecting the resampling or hierarchical rule.
uncertainty.rationale: The source figure-level uncertainty does not define a confirmatory panel win rule. Paired replicates, repeated-session clustering, multiplicity and the decision criterion remain to be fixed before final scoring.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate the complete original Figure 5A-D cohort, preprocessing, protocol and all four targets across PO, LP, DG, CA1 and VISa, preserving all applicable author conditions and controls.

Recover the published panel endpoint vector and calibrate independent runs of the appropriate source author models, keeping published scores and rerun scores separate. Preserve source stochastic protocol semantics; document rerun seeds and a prespecified calibration tolerance instead of demanding identical historical randomness.

Compare the candidate and relevant source-paper models on paired common evaluation cases under matched allowed inputs and budgets. Require predeclared meaningful improvement and valid dependence-aware uncertainty while preventing selective region/target omission or unreported regression.

Freeze candidate source, hyperparameters, reference versions, selection rules, calibration tolerance and statistical criterion before protected final scoring; retain every required case and undefined score explicitly.

Keep prospective40, changed cohorts/splits and unvalidated preprocessing repairs as extensions. Do not require unrelated F1-F8/S1-S8 figures to claim a fully supported improvement on this complete original Figure 5A-D task.

Preserve original single-session linear/MLP/RRR and applicable state-space, multi-session, multi-region and combined comparisons. The combined state-space decoder is not an original condition for wheel speed or whisker motion energy; do not invent it.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparator has been independently source-verified. A future source-paper win would not automatically establish current SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive pending source recovery. Then iterate using approved original-panel training/validation feedback, with source-permitted state-space priors and matched author-model information access. No final-test feedback is available for selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Hash candidate, preprocessing, selected models and author release; fix panel cohort/protocol, training schedule, paired evaluation design, calibration tolerance, meaningful effects and uncertainty rule before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Capture candidate and admitted author-model outputs before protected scoring on the complete Figure 5A-D panel. Preserve all original targets, regions, conditions and controls. Report altered-cohort or prospective40 results separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Require independent source-author reference runs for the selected panel with authenticated provenance and a prespecified reproduction/calibration tolerance. Match candidate/reference evaluation cases and declare stochastic replication, data access and measured compute allowances. Local references, generated diagnostics and oracle behavior cannot establish the paper comparator.

blocking_issues: Exact immutable RE data release and Figure 5A-D session/animal/region/unit identities are not authenticated.
Published numeric Figure 5A-D results, original score-producing metric implementations and panel aggregation remain unrecovered.
Final-paper preprocessing and training recipe differ from the example cache/loader/training path; selected-panel source equivalence is unestablished.
Original prior identity, state-space sequence support, empirical BMM prior, LG readout and author model-selection settings remain unqualified for the selected panel.
The original stochastic split protocol must be identified and a calibrated, provenance-controlled rerun route established; exact historical seed replay is not a universal prerequisite.
No complete admitted evaluator, competent author-reference execution, fixed access/resource budget or prespecified meaningful-effect/uncertainty policy is established for Figure 5A-D.

legacy.notes: Preserve the full accepted inactive V5 implementation, all historical F1-F8/S1-S8 panels, author contexts and generated diagnostics. Their reconstruction/source-composition checks are calibration only. The active design selects the complete original Figure 5A-D decoding task; unrelated legacy panels and prospective40 are neither substituted for it nor mandatory gates for that task.
